svg.text: The wanted box sits in the BACK row of the BOTTOM level, and the only free row slot is at the top.
worst case ≈ 18.4 s to the exit (limit 30 s)
lift 0.6 m/s · row move 178 mm = 6 half-turns, 1.3 s
store full: 25 of 26 row slots used
Top view of the lift: one row = boxes side by side
front fence · NFC antenna strip (12 antennas) under the belt · blade at the right end
0 Plan: target in the back row of level 1
1 Lift down to level 1 (blade passes 12 slots) 3.3 s
2 Belts −6 half-turns: front row onto the lift 1.8 s
3 Lift up to level 13 (the free slot) 3.3 s
4 Belts +6: blocker row pushed into level 13 1.3 s
6 Belts −6: target row onto the lift, NFC 1.8 s
7 Up to the exit, shutter opens 3.6 s = 18.4 s
8 Transport lifts the box out from above
Nothing is restored after a dig: the blocker row stays
at level 13; the free slot wanders like a sliding-puzzle hole.
Typical pick (front row, mid level) ≈ 5.7 s;
free slot kept mid-height: worst case ≈ 15.6 s.
Mean ≈ 8 s ("last used goes to the front row").

g.text: 0 The store is full. Wanted: a box in the back row of the bottom level; the only free row slot is at the top
1 The lift drops to level 1; its upright blade slides through the open slot hubs of the 12 levels above
2 Docked: the blade turns level 1’s roller with the lift belt — the front (blocker) row rides onto the lift
3 The lift carries the blocker row up to level 13, which has one free row slot
4 Both belts run the other way: the blocker row is pushed in, level 13’s row moves to the back
5 The empty lift goes back down to level 1
6 Belts again: the target row rides onto the lift; the NFC strip confirms the box
7 Up to the exit: the last 30 mm of travel push the shutter open — box ready after 18.4 s
8 The transport grips the wanted box under its rim and lifts it out through the port
9 Meanwhile the lift takes the other boxes of the row back into level 1
